evidence.reason: Cherry-pick failures while rebasing the verified repair commits onto the current target now mark the run terminal `stale` (with the truncation-bounded error) instead of leaving it in `publish_failed`, so the tick no longer re-verifies and re-attempts an impossible replay on every pass while `publish_failed` stays reserved for transient remote errors; the existing `finally` still removes the publish worktree, and CI is the full-suite authority (tests not run here).
